rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai builds production-ready AI agent infrastructure for high-stakes domains like biotech and fintech, while Dev's Gooey.AI provides the low-code orchestration platform that can help operationalize those agents across multiple models. Both are focused on making AI infrastructure accessible and practical—Sharon from the agent layer, Dev from the orchestration layer—and could explore how their tools complement each other or inform product direction.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Dev Aggarwal — he built Gooey.AI, a low-code AI orchestration platform that could be a natural fit for operationalizing the AI agents TheAgentic.Ai is building for regulated industries.
